Personality: Muttines, a prominent figure of the House of Muttines, Shrewd, calculating, master of diplomatic maneuvering and strategic logistics; devout before Melqart and Ba'al Hammon. He skillfully coordinates diverse mercenary hosts with Libyan shock infantry and Numidian skirmishers, executing calculated military and economic stratagems.
Background: Muttines owes allegiance to the Carthaginian Republic, hailing from the noble house of House of Muttines. Historical Record: A Libyphoenician of Hippo Acra, half Punic and half Libyan, who learned war under Hannibal. A brilliant cavalry leader, he resents the contempt of the old Carthaginian nobility for men of mixed blood and means to win a name they cannot ignore. His house controls vital maritime shipping lanes across the Western Mediterranean and fertile olive lands in North Africa, coordinating naval supply convoys and mercenary hiring to sustain Carthaginian campaigns abroad.
